entries.entry: Alright, here goes... So, it's New Year's Day, and honestly, I'm feeling a bit defeated about meditation. Tried that mindfulness stuff again, but I just can't get into it; it's like my brain's refusing to cooperate. Had this weird dream last night that I can't make heads or tails of, and it's frustrating. On a brighter note, had a great time with mates last night, and it's amazing how laughter makes everything better. Family's been lovely too - can't beat the chaos of our gatherings. Gaming has been solid, smashed a few levels. Just need to sort my whistling skills, really! Work's got me feeling mixed too.

Alright, here goes. So, it's Thursday, 02 January 2020. The weather's pretty bleak - classic Sheffield winter, grey skies and drizzle. I had to sit through yet another family gathering yesterday, and honestly, it was draining. Everyone kept asking about my plans, as if I had everything figured out. I get it, but I'm really just trying to find my way right now. Wish they'd lighten up a bit on the expectations. And they just don't get my interests, like gardening. Honestly, you'd think I was trying to cultivate a jungle the way they go on about my lack of green fingers. But hey, let's talk about the good stuff. I've been dreaming about our future travel plans. I can practically feel the beach sand between my toes when I think of Bali. And I've got flights in mind for later this year - can't wait to get away! Badminton was a mixed bag today. I had a decent match, but I messed up my serve a couple of times. Frustrating! Then there's this old mate I've reconnected with. We shared a laugh about our terrible gaming techniques. Felt good, though we both know we could be better. And Sarah sent me this lovely text about kindness today, which lifted my spirits. It's moments like that that remind me, despite everything, we've still got each other. Anyway, time to remember my goals and keep moving forward.
